title: Iterated fan-out reduction
statement: Given a natural number $n$ and a list of gates, start with the empty gate list, the identity vertex map, and counter $n$, then apply the one-step fan-out reduction successively to each gate in the given list. The resulting gate list, vertex map, and counter form the output.
